# Baeldung

> A comprehensive resource for Java, Spring, and web development tutorials with transparent business metrics and community-driven content.

Baeldung provides in-depth technical tutorials, courses, and guides for developers learning Java, Spring Framework, REST APIs, and related technologies. The site maintains transparent quarterly reports on traffic, strategy, and business metrics, demonstrating a commitment to open communication with its audience.

## Key Topics

- Spring Framework
- Spring MVC
- REST API
- CRUD Operations
- Java
- Controller Development
- @PathVariable
- HTTP
- CI/CD
- Jenkins
- GitHub
- Postman
- Business Metrics
- Traffic Analytics
- Content Strategy

## Learning & Courses

- [Lesson 2: Expanding Our First Controller](https://courses.baeldung.com/courses/487981/lectures/10132704): Spring MVC controller development tutorial covering REST APIs and CRUD operations

## About & Company

- [About Baeldung](http://meta.baeldung.com/about): About Baeldung: Java and web tech site sharing traffic metrics and public iteration
- [Meta Baeldung](http://meta.baeldung.com/): Baeldung's transparent quarterly reports and business metrics on traffic and strategy

## Optional

- [Dashboard - Jenkins](https://jenkins.baeldung.com/): Jenkins CI/CD build dashboard for Baeldung tutorials project monitoring
